intro: Where most hotels in central Yasothon lean plain and budget, The Colour Hotel takes a different path — a 45-room boutique design hotel on Witthaya Thamrong Road that deliberately decorates each room in a different bright colour theme · Built in 2015, so the rooms are fairly new, with comfy beds, good linen, cold A/C, an LCD TV, a refrigerator, strong Wi-Fi, free parking and 24-hour service · The location is central, near the Ban Singha Tha old town, Wat Maha That and the town market · From approx. ฿450/night · Real guest reviews agree the rooms are clean, good value and the staff friendly · TripAdvisor ranks it #1 of 3 hotels in Yasothon — review volume is still thin, but what's there is almost all positive.

body.html: The Colour Hotel is a 45-room boutique design hotel in central Yasothon, on Witthaya Thamrong Road in the Nai Mueang subdistrict · Built in 2015, the building and rooms are fairly new compared with the town's older hotels · The signature, true to its name, is that each room is decorated in a different bright colour theme — a small design hotel that feels fresh and far from generic, ideal for travellers who want accommodation with character at a few hundred baht · Rooms come in standard and larger layouts, suiting solo travellers, couples and small families.

What guests consistently praise is that the rooms are clean, the beds comfy, the linen good, the A/C cold and the Wi-Fi genuinely strong · Every room has a large LCD TV, a refrigerator/minibar, complimentary water and a shower bathroom with toiletries · Many reviews say the room condition is better than the price suggests, kept clean, with a comfortable overall feel · The hotel runs 24 hours with round-the-clock check-in and free parking, very handy for self-drivers or anyone arriving in Yasothon late · Its compact size means attentive service — staff recognise guests and help out in a friendly way.
"The room was cutely colour-themed, clean, the bed comfy, A/C cold, Wi-Fi good and parking free · central, a short hop to Ban Singha Tha, and at a few hundred baht it's great value."

Location is another advantage · The hotel is central in Yasothon on Witthaya Thamrong Road, near the Ban Singha Tha old town — the row of old wooden shophouses that's the town's signature spot — and close to Wat Maha That, the Yasothon city museum and the town market · Eateries, cafés and convenience stores surround the hotel, so food is easy to find day and night · It suits visitors exploring the old town, official-business travellers, or anyone stopping over for a night on an Isan trip · Phaya Thaen Park and the city's green spaces are a short drive away.

To be straight with you, per real guest reviews: the limitation that comes up is that some rooms have no window, or only a small one, which can feel stuffy or dark for anyone who likes natural light · It's a small hotel focused purely on rooms — no pool, gym or large restaurant like a bigger property · And because it's a small place in a secondary town, online review volume is still low, so the overall picture comes from a modest pool of guests, even if what's there is almost all positive.

In short: if you want accommodation in central Yasothon that's got design, clean and newish rooms, comfy beds, free parking and a central location, at a few hundred baht — The Colour Hotel is a fitting choice with more character than the town's usual hotels · TripAdvisor ranks it #1 of 3 hotels in Yasothon, and the real-review scores lean positive · It suits couples, solo travellers and small families who value cleanliness and value over a full set of facilities.

A tip from following the reviews here: when you book, ask for a room with a window, since some rooms have none or only a small one — if you like a bright room, request it up front · Call the hotel directly (045-971794) if you'd like a particular colour theme, as each room differs · And since it's open 24 hours, a late arrival is no problem — you can check in any time.

faq.q: Where is The Colour Hotel in Yasothon, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The Colour Hotel is at 441/1 Witthaya Thamrong Road, Nai Mueang subdistrict, in central Yasothon · It's about a 5-minute drive from the Ban Singha Tha old town, Wat Maha That, the Yasothon city museum and the town market · Eateries, cafés and convenience stores surround the hotel, so food is easy to find day and night.

faq.q: How much does The Colour Hotel cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿450/night for a Standard Room · Superior, Deluxe and Family rooms run about ฿600-฿900 · Prices vary by room type and season, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: What makes The Colour Hotel special, and why is it called a boutique hotel?
faq.a: Its signature is that each room is decorated in a different bright colour theme, design-hotel style · It's a small 45-room hotel built in 2015, so rooms are fairly new — comfy beds, cold A/C, strong Wi-Fi — with more character than the town's usual hotels, at a few hundred baht.

faq.q: Who is The Colour Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for couples, solo travellers and small families who want accommodation with design, clean and newish rooms, and a central location at a few hundred baht · It suits old-town visitors, official-business travellers and anyone stopping over for a night on an Isan trip, favouring cleanliness and value over a full set of facilities.

faq.q: Does every room at The Colour Hotel have a window?
faq.a: Not every room · Per real guest reviews, some rooms have no window or only a small one, which can feel dark for anyone who likes natural light · If you prefer a bright room, request a window room when booking, or call the hotel directly (045-971794) first.

faq.q: Does The Colour Hotel have a pool or parking?
faq.a: No pool, but there's free parking · It's a small, rooms-only hotel open 24 hours with round-the-clock check-in · If you want a hotel with a swimming pool in Yasothon, consider one of the larger properties in this review series.
